prompt: Who was the second non-Asian men's soccer player to pass 100 international goals, and has long since passed the previous record international goalscorer, Iran's Ali Daei (109)?
answer: Lionel Messi was the second non-Asian men’s player to surpass 100 international goals, after Cristiano Ronaldo. Messi also passed Ali Daei’s former record of 109 goals.
